Maya will deliver homepage copy, Alex will conduct the accessibility audit, and Sam will draft the launch email. The existing email platform will be used, and the analytics dashboard is excluded from this release. Support monitoring for launch day remains to be assigned.

Use the existing email platform instead of migrating before launch.
